records.text: Treasury Secretary Bessent calls a $2 trillion dollar-stablecoin market "reasonable" — the doctrine stated plainly: GENIUS-regulated stablecoins as a Treasury-demand machine and a dollar-export weapon. Said the same day gold passes the euro. The two poles named on the same date, by the same system.

records.title: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system …
records.text: Project Pine — the New York Fed and the BIS Innovation Hub, with the ECB, Bank of England and four others — proves central banks can run monetary policy in a fully tokenized system: interest on reserves, asset purchases, collateral calls, all by smart contract. The central banks aren't fighting the ledger; they're learning to drive it.
